## Nucor Invites You to Join Its Third Quarter of 2026 Conference Call on the Web


10/13/2026


[Download (opens in new window) PDF 149 KB](https://s202.q4cdn.com/531038915/files/doc_news/Nucor-Invites-You-to-Join-Its-Third-Quarter-of-2026-Conference-Call-on-the-Web-2026.pdf)


CHARLOTTE, N.C.


, Oct. 13, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- In conjunction with Nucor's (NYSE: NUE) third quarter earnings release, you are invited to listen to its live conference call with host Leon Topalian, Nucor's Chair and Chief Executive Officer. This conference call will include a review of Nucor's results for the third quarter ended October 3, 2026, followed by a question-and-answer session. The event will be available on the internet on October 27, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. Eastern Time.


What:


Nucor's Third Quarter of 2026 Conference Call


When:


10:00 a.m. Eastern Time on Tuesday, October 27, 2026


Where:


[https://events.q4inc.com/attendee/211704259](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4795633-1&h=3480322757&u=https%3A%2F%2Fnam04.safelinks.protection.outlook.com%2F%3Furl%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fevents.q4inc.com%252Fattendee%252F211704259%26data%3D05%257C02%257Cblakelee.dunkelberg%2540nucor.com%257C251195bea68b4fddee8908df181b888a%257C9ee0b1d30ba84efe82d7b61d6eae73ed%257C0%257C0%257C639256178719122761%257CUnknown%257CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%253D%253D%257C0%257C%257C%257C%26sdata%3D3qjlxgmEPQ%252F8tHgjzi3fQhlpmo9yHfZc4dlcF37hC30%253D%26reserved%3D0&a=https%3A%2F%2Fevents.q4inc.com%2Fattendee%2F211704259) or at[https://nucor.com/](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4795633-1&h=4118969348&u=https%3A%2F%2Fnucor.com%2F&a=https%3A%2F%2Fnucor.com%2F)


How:


Log on to the web at either of the addresses above


Archive:


If you are unable to participate during the live webcast, the archived call will
be available at[http://www.nucor.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4795633-1&h=32104312&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.nucor.com%2F&a=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.nucor.com) .


Nucor and its affiliates are manufacturers of steel and steel products, with operating facilities in the United States, Canada and Mexico. Products produced include: carbon and alloy steel -- in bars, beams, sheet and plate; hollow structural section tubing; electrical conduit; steel racking; steel piling; steel joists and joist girders; steel deck; fabricated concrete reinforcing steel; cold finished steel; precision castings; steel fasteners; metal building systems; insulated metal panels; overhead doors; steel grating; wire and wire mesh; and utility structures. Nucor, through The David J. Joseph Company and its affiliates, also brokers ferrous and nonferrous metals, pig iron and hot briquetted iron / direct reduced iron; supplies ferro-alloys; and processes ferrous and nonferrous scrap. Nucor is North America's largest recycler.
